_meta.purpose: Curated list of NSE-listed names that traded during 2008-2024 but were delisted, restructured, or otherwise zeroed out — and which yfinance silently drops from the historical universe. Used by examples/nse_survivorship_estimate.py to compute a more honest survivorship penalty than the visible-exits-only baseline.
_meta.warning: This list is INCOMPLETE and CONSERVATIVE on purpose. It captures only well-documented public collapses. The true universe of NSE delistings/insolvencies between 2008-2024 is several hundred names. For a more rigorous correction, subscribe to a paid data feed (EOD Historical Data ~$30/mo or Trendlyne) and use the --eod-historical mode in nse_universe_pit.py instead.

format.ticker: NSE trading symbol at time of last activity
format.first_active_year: approximate year the name was actively traded (lower bound)
format.last_active_year: year the name was effectively delisted/zeroed
format.approx_total_return_pct: rough peak-to-delisting return for someone holding from first_active_year to last_active_year. Negative; conservative estimates.
